verdict.rationale: The docs imply Codex runs commands inside a sandbox, with rules governing which commands may run outside it ([chatgpt-docs-95]). Codex can also run tests ([chatgpt-docs-27], [chatgpt-docs-39]), and admins can restrict network access ([chatgpt-docs-88]). That points to an isolated execution environment, but nothing describes a dedicated sandbox that keeps testing away from production data or accounts. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an isolated test/sandbox environment separated from production data, a description of the sandbox's data and network isolation guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
